_readme: HUMAN OVERRIDES for the Did You Know factoids, es. Always wins.
scripts/translate.mjs READS this file and merges it on top of DeepL's
output. It never writes here. To fix a bad factoid translation, add the
key HERE -- do not edit factoids.es.json, which is regenerated on every run.
These are FACTUAL claims about writing systems and computing history. A
mistranslated date, quantity, attribution or causal link makes a stated
fact false. The generator enforces that every figure in the English
appears in the output, in order -- but it cannot check meaning. Corrections
here should be made against the English source, not against the machine
Keys are factoid_NNN and match public/locales/factoids.en.json.
factoid_004: La palabra «emoji» proviene del japonés e (imagen) + moji (carácter); en realidad, no deriva de la palabra inglesa «emotion», a pesar del parecido fortuito.
